_comment: Old API reference pages for tools ADSMCP does not have (or has but marks not implemented). The page stays at its URL as a 'not supported yet' stub; `use` lists real tools to call instead; `note` is optional extra guidance.

api-reference/general/switch-primary-acc.note: ADSMCP has no primary-account setting. Pass the account id to each tool call instead.

api-reference/google-ads/get-benchmark-c.note: ADSMCP does not ship industry benchmarks. It compares your own data against the targets in your Business Context.

api-reference/google-ads/get-business-pr.note: Business details live on the dashboard Business Context and Brand pages.

api-reference/google-ads/infer-business-.note: Fill in Business Context on the dashboard; your own AI model can summarize your site for you.

api-reference/google-ads/save-business-p.note: Save business details on the dashboard Business Context and Brand pages.

api-reference/monitoring/get-research-st.note: ADSMCP has no background research jobs; these tools return their result in the same call.

api-reference/monitoring/start-research.note: ADSMCP has no background research jobs; these tools return their result in the same call.
